parsed.name: UHFQA量子分析控制器
parsed.description: 这是一台苏黎世仪器的 UHFQA 超高频量子分析/控制仪器，用于量子实验中的读出脉冲生成、AWG波形下载、积分权重配置、DIO触发与时序校准，以及光谱测量模式配置。
parsed.description_en: This is a Zurich Instruments UHFQA ultra-high-frequency quantum analyzer/controller used in quantum experiments for readout pulse generation, AWG waveform loading, integration weight configuration, DIO triggering and timing calibration, and spectroscopy mode setup.

actions.description: 加载仪器默认设置，并可上传默认AWG序列与读出相关配置。
actions.description_en: Load default instrument settings, optionally uploading a default AWG sequence and readout-related configuration.

actions.description: 从文本文件加载AWG程序到仪器。
actions.description_en: Load an AWG program onto the instrument from a text file.

actions.description: 通过兼容接口从文件加载AWG程序。
actions.description_en: Load an AWG program from a file through a backward-compatible interface.

actions.description: 更新指定索引的AWG波形数据。
actions.description_en: Update AWG waveform data at a specified index.

actions.description: 绘制DIO位线数据以检查数字输入输出时序。
actions.description_en: Plot DIO bit-line data to inspect digital input/output timing.

actions.description: 配置单边带读出的积分权重与旋转参数。
actions.description_en: Prepare integration weights and rotation parameters for single-sideband readout.

actions.description: 配置双边带读出的积分权重与旋转参数。
actions.description_en: Prepare integration weights and rotation parameters for double-sideband readout.

actions.description: 绘制当前DIO快照以查看数字位状态。
actions.description_en: Plot a current DIO snapshot to inspect digital bit states.

actions.description: 获取仪器当前状态的JSON兼容快照。
actions.description_en: Get a JSON-compatible snapshot of the current instrument state.

actions.description: 加载并配置由DIO触发的脉冲与采集AWG序列。
actions.description_en: Load and configure an AWG sequence for acquisition with DIO-triggered pulses.

actions.description: 加载用于DIO相关RED测试的脉冲与采集AWG序列。
actions.description_en: Load an AWG sequence for acquisition and pulse generation in a DIO-related RED test.

actions.description: 加载用于数字测试图样输出的AWG序列。
actions.description_en: Load an AWG sequence that outputs a digital test pattern.

actions.description: 加载同时执行脉冲输出与数据采集的AWG序列。
actions.description_en: Load an AWG sequence that performs pulse output together with data acquisition.

actions.description: 加载仅用于数据采集的AWG序列。
actions.description_en: Load an AWG sequence for data acquisition only.

actions.description: 加载带调试延迟设置的数据采集序列。
actions.description_en: Load a data acquisition sequence with debug delay settings.

actions.description: 加载单边带调制读出脉冲与采集AWG序列。
actions.description_en: Load an AWG sequence for single-sideband modulated readout pulse generation and acquisition.

actions.description: 开启光谱测量模式并配置内部振荡器、窗口和读出参数。
actions.description_en: Enable spectroscopy mode and configure the internal oscillator, windowing, and readout parameters.

actions.description: 关闭光谱测量模式并恢复默认读出配置。
actions.description_en: Disable spectroscopy mode and restore default readout configuration.

actions.description: 输出DIO校准数据用于数字接口时序校准。
actions.description_en: Output DIO calibration data for digital interface timing calibration.

actions.description: 校准DIO协议时序与延迟设置。
actions.description_en: Calibrate DIO protocol timing and delay settings.

actions.description: 与中央控制器配合校准DIO协议。
actions.description_en: Calibrate the DIO protocol in coordination with a central controller.
